Many of his early years were marked by his status as a lost boy in Neverland, a land of eternal youth and adventure. As a child, he reveled in the carefree existence alongside his fellow lost boys. However, his world was upended when he fell in love with Pan's own fairy, and learned of Pan's dark secret: those who grew up were ruthlessly disposed of by the never aging boy. With a heart heavy with loss and the weight of his guilt, Hartley renounced his former identity and managed to escape Neverland. He was eventually taken in by a kind old pirate named Smee, and he grew up to become a notorious pirate, captain of the Jolly Roger. His sole purpose is to seek vengeance against Pan for the lives he took and the innocence he stole from the lost boys, while searching for a way to rescue future children from the grasp of Neverland.
